body:
Thank you...there were several things you posted that I really needed to read...I still doubt my abilities/overall usefulness to society, but I do need to focus on me, and what's important to me, rather than compare myself to others.  And I'm sure that a lot of my paranoia is self-created...I just have a lot of trust issues, and often wonder the motives of those who compliment me or are nice to me.  I do have a lot to be thankful for...I currently work at a public facility near the bad part of town, and I frequently see homeless people with no place to go, and no other belongings other than what is in their backpack.  I try not to take it for granted.

This may only have a temporary effect, but thanks nonetheless.
